## Abstract

The EU-funded Soils4Africa project's aimed to provide an open-access soil information system with a set of key indicators and underpinning data, accompanied by a methodology for repeated soil monitoring across the African continent. 



This release contains the field data which has been collected by a large number of field surveyors from over 15,000 locations across 33 countries in Africa, through a mobile application. Description of the sampling locations largely followed FAO's Guidelines for Soil Description.


The 's4a_field_data' file contains the data. The 'tableschema' file has description of the columns, following the tableschema conventions.


Read more about the project at <https://cordis.europa.eu/project/id/862900/results>

 

IMPORTANT: quality control of the data is still ongoing. Updates and new versions of the dataset are expected in the future.
